description: This file defines the SourceEditing class for CKEditor 5 integration within Drupal, handling configuration, validation, and element subset management for source editing features.

classes.name: SourceEditing
classes.description: A plugin class for CKEditor 5 source editing configuration within Drupal, managing allowed HTML tags and element subsets.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for allowed HTML tags in source editing.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates and processes the allowed tags configuration input.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for allowed tags.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns a subset of allowed HTML elements based on configuration.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Generates dynamic plugin configuration for HTML support based on allowed tags.
